_comment: English translations for World Spinner UI. This file contains all user-facing strings for the application.

capytan.label: Capytan
capytan.tip1: Spin the globe to meet a mystery country.
capytan.tip2: Use the next clue if the first one feels tricky.
capytan.tip3: Correct guesses earn a new discovery card!

clueBoard.emptyState: Spin the globe to get your first animal clue.

feedback.correct: Yes! You discovered {country}. Spin again for a new mystery.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. Peek at another clue and try again.
feedback.emptyGuess: Type a country name before guessing.
feedback.noActiveCountry: Spin the globe to start your adventure.

discoveryLog.emptyState: No cards yet. Spin the globe and follow the clues to unlock your first country.
